Live from the PM tool, cached 15 minutes (plan §11).

Items reported as done whose ticket isn't Done in the PM tool (plan §11 mv_said_vs_pm).

An item counts as "the ticket is done" only when it names the ticket itself (summary ≈ ticket title),
so finishing a sub-task ("refund API tests") isn't flagged against the parent ticket.

put.description:
Saves the schedule, creates/updates the recurring meeting and upserts the Temporal Schedule.

Order matters for the compensating step (plan §7.1): DB row first (inside the request transaction),
then the external calls; if Temporal fails we raise, the transaction rolls back and the meeting
invite is harmless to resend on the next save.

post.description: Templates are immutable: saving always creates and activates a new version (plan §4.1).

Directory sync. Users are JIT-provisioned at first OIDC sign-in; a SCIM/Keycloak admin sync can
plug in here. Today this refreshes nothing remotely and reports the current roster size.
Right to erasure (plan §12): redact transcript text and speaker link, delete updates, keep an audit entry.
